# Process to identify currently missing drivers

<span style="color: blue;">"At least answer the question–Is there anything besides fishing that is affecting this stock?"</span>

Suggestions:

*  US Ecosystem Socioeconomic Profiles process
    +  Priority stocks only
    +  Start with a conceptual model
    +  Ensure linkages to stock dynamics
    
*  ICES Benchmark EBFM ToR

*  ICES MSE special requests, how are these currently scoped?
    +  Compressed timeframes
    +  Can and do include stakeholders but see point above

## Example Components of the Process

<span style="color: blue;">Stock specific ecosystem indicators</span> can be derived from literature review combined with indicator testing using an Ecosystem Socioeconomic Profile report (Alaska, Northeast),  

![:img Bluefish ESP conceptual model](https://github.com/NOAA-EDAB/presentations/raw/master/docs/EDAB_images/bluefishconceptualmodel.png)
or using a **structured conversation among experts** as piloted in the Pacific

* experts can include stakeholders
* information can include citizen science

.footnote[
Image courtesy Abigail Tyrell, NEFSC
]
]

--

.pull-right-60[
##[Pacific ecosystem factors](https://www.pcouncil.org/documents/2024/08/h-1-a-cciea-team-report-1-cciea-risk-table-report-on-fep-initiative-4.pdf/)

*  Food webs (e.g., predator abundance or productivity, competitor abundance or productivity, spatial overlap with predators/competitors, prey abundance) 

*  Habitat availability (e.g., do current or near-term predictions of ocean temperatures and oxygen match known optimal ranges for [priority species] life history stages, closed area regulations) 

*  Changes in ecosystem productivity (e.g., upwelling indices, chlorophyll a, abundance of low trophic level organisms)  

*  Physiological indices (e.g., growth, condition, pathogens/parasites, stomach weight/fullness) 

*  Reproductive indices (e.g., maturity, fecundity, spawn timing and duration)  


<span style="color: blue;">**Should WGSAM focus on providing suggestions for our specialty--food webs? Changing ecosystem productivity?**</span>
]

# MSE technical specifications and/or review criteria

*  Included factors follow the process described in the previous slides to ensure most relevant things dealt with first

*  Review modeling tools available add to process as well as the lit review

*  Then--best practices for including the factors in models

*  When do you need a full ecosystem OM? see examples

*  When do you need a full assessment included? offer acceptable alternatives

*  Can we sketch some guidelines?

* Projections: when you dont have your factor in the future, how to project?
    + Empirical vs Ecosystem informed OM
    + Hybrid?

How do we use it in the advice?
